input: Lack of capability or robustness is a risk associated with An advertising system utilizes artificial intelligence to ensure brand safety by analyzing content and blocking inappropriate ads. It uses machine learning algorithms to identify and filter out unsuitable advertisements, providing a secure environment for brands to reach their audiences.
